name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.31
body:
## 更新内容（安卓 v0.1.31）

这一版把查验证码、开代理和系统自带的常用小工具改成一直能用，完全锁定期间也能打开。

- 身份验证器默认放行，包括 Google 身份验证器、Microsoft Authenticator、Authy、Aegis、2FAS、FreeOTP 和 FreeOTP+。
- Clash 类代理默认放行，包括 Clash for Android、Clash Meta for Android 和 FlClash。
- 系统自带的计算器、录音机、便签、天气、指南针、收音机和翻译默认放行，覆盖 OPPO、一加、小米、vivo、华为、荣耀、三星、Pixel 和魅族。三星和魅族自带的工具箱里有手电筒，也一起放行。其他手机的手电筒在下拉快捷开关里，本来就能用。
- 电话和短信补上了各厂商的系统版本，换了默认拨号或短信 App 也照常能用。
- 运营商营业厅这类自带拨号功能的第三方 App，以前会被当成电话一直放行，现在按普通 App 的规则来。你自己设成默认拨号的 App 仍然放行。
- 这些 App 不占「专注时可用」的名额，也不算进整台手机的使用时长。在「专注时可用」页面，它们显示在「这些 App 一直能用，不占名额」那一组。
- 已知限制：这一版在 OPPO 手机上覆盖安装过，数据保留，无障碍服务正常连回；新放行的 App 在完全锁定时段还没逐个在真机上打开试过。有的手机自带天气里带资讯或广告入口。这些改动只在安卓上有，iPhone 版没有更新，仍是 v0.1.5。

## What's New (Android v0.1.31)

Authenticator apps, proxy apps and the small tools that come with your phone now always open, even during Complete Lock.

- Authenticator apps are allowed by default: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, Aegis, 2FAS, FreeOTP and FreeOTP+.
- Clash proxy apps are allowed by default: Clash for Android, Clash Meta for Android and FlClash.
- The built in calculator, recorder, notes, weather, compass, radio and translator are allowed by default on OPPO, OnePlus, Xiaomi, vivo, Huawei, Honor, Samsung, Pixel and Meizu phones. The toolbox apps on Samsung and Meizu include a flashlight and are allowed too. On other phones the flashlight lives in quick settings and already worked.
- Phone and Messages now cover each maker's built in apps, so they keep working even if you switch the default dialer or SMS app.
- Third party apps with a dialer inside, such as carrier service apps, used to count as the phone app and were always allowed. They now follow your normal rules. An app you set as your default dialer is still allowed.
- These apps take no slots in Allowed in Focus and do not count toward whole phone usage. On the Allowed in Focus page they appear under These apps always work and take no slots.
- Known limits: this version was installed as an update on an OPPO phone, data was kept and the accessibility service reconnected. The newly allowed apps have not each been opened on a real phone during Complete Lock yet. The built in weather app on some phones has news or ad sections. These changes are Android only. The iPhone app was not updated and remains v0.1.5.
